high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a presentation at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC). The slide is titled "The Big World Perspective: The world is much bigger and more complex than the agent." It features a visual comparison between a globe and a stick figure, symbolizing the vastness and complexity of the world compared to an individual or agent. On the right side of the image, there is a photograph of a speaker standing behind a podium. The speaker appears to be mid-speech, gesturing with their hands while holding a microphone.
